Overview

With over 17,000 employees worldwide, the mission of the Customer Experience & Success (CE&S) organization is to empower customers to accelerate business value through differentiated customer experiences that leverage Microsoft’s products and services, ignited by our people and culture. Come join CE&S and help us build a future where customers achieve their business outcomes faster with technology that does more. 

Imagine helping some of Switzerland's leading organizations change how work gets done, with an impact that reaches across industries, communities and lives worldwide. As a Cloud Solution Architect for Copilot and Agents, you will do exactly that with Microsoft 365 Copilot, agents and artificial intelligence.

You will work closely with business and technical stakeholders to turn modern cloud and AI capabilities into real-world scenarios that drive innovation and measurable value. Your role sits where strategy meets execution. You will shape how customers adopt, scale and govern AI as part of their digital transformation.

You will combine your understanding of customer goals, market trends and Microsoft cloud architectures to guide organizations from first experiments to lasting transformation. You will help customers:

  • Find the use cases that matter most
  • Design adoption approaches that work for their people
  • Remove the blockers that slow them down

The result is measurable productivity gains and better business outcomes.

Your impact goes beyond a single engagement. You will work across Microsoft and bring customer feedback to the product teams that shape the platform. You will also contribute to best-practice guidance and reusable patterns that help many more customers succeed.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.



Responsibilities
  • Focus on customer and partner experience through efficient delivery, ensuring a seamless and connected engagement that supports value realization, improved satisfaction, and acceleration of transformation.
  • Act as the voice of the customer by sharing feedback, insights, success stories, and strategic or technical input with internal teams, and contribute to identifying patterns across customers or industries that inform actionable insights and product improvements.
  • Contribute to identifying, escalating, and mitigating technical and business blockers using appropriate tools and processes to accelerate solution deployment, usage, and business outcome realization.
  • Help customers adopt and use solutions aligned with Microsoft product and platform strategy by translating business problems into industry solutions, explaining the business value and return on investment.
  • Collaborate across Microsoft and customer or partner teams to deliver on-strategy engagements, manage business and technical risks in line with governance principles, and ensure work complies with industry and Microsoft guidelines and procedures.


Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business or related field AND experience in cloud/infrastructure technologies, information technology (IT) consulting/support, systems administration, network operations, software development/support, technology solutions, practice development, architecture, and/or consulting OR equivalent experience
    • OR equivalent experience
  • As this role will involve collaboration with local customers, fluency in German is required.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, or related field AND solid experience in cloud/infrastructure technologies, information technology (IT) consulting/support, systems administration, network operations, software development/support, technology solutions, practice development, architecture, and/or consulting
    • OR equivalent experience
  • Solid experience working in a customer-facing role (e.g., internal and/or external)
  • Solid experience working on technical projects
  • Technical Certification in Cloud (e.g., Azure, Amazon Web Services, Google, security certifications)
  • Fluency in French


Cloud Solution Architecture IC4 - The typical base pay range for this role across Switzerland is CHF 126,000.00 - CHF 208,700.00 per year. Certain roles may be eligible for benefits and other compensation.

Find additional benefits and pay information here:
https://careers.microsoft.com/v2/global/en/corporate-pay/switzerland-corporate-pay.html

Overview

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Microsoft’s software supply chain depends on controls that span every step—from code and build through signing, scanning, vaulting, distribution, and licensing. The Trust and Secure Services (TSS) portfolio provides critical end-to-end assurance. Centralized code signing establishes a verifiable chain of trust, while malware and vulnerability scanning enforce policy gates and help prevent compromised artifacts from reaching customers. Secure vaulting and controlled distribution protect validated content, and a unified publishing pipeline keeps controls consistent across endpoints and clouds. Content protection, licensing, and activation enforce entitlements at runtime, protecting customers and Microsoft intellectual property. Together, TSS services help keep the software supply chain intact, traceable, and resilient to evolving threats.

As a Business Operations Program Manager on the Trust and Secure Services team, you will own programs and processes that protect Microsoft products and services throughout the digital supply chain. You will apply technical understanding and program management skills to create clarity and deliver results that meet business and customer needs. At Microsoft, our mission—to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more—guides how we partner with customers to deliver trusted, impactful solutions. With a growth mindset culture, we innovate responsibly and measure success by shared progress for people, teams, and customers. Join us to do meaningful work that changes the world and helps shape what’s next for everyone.



Responsibilities
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for operational requests, providing timely guidance to internal partners, resolving inquiries, and escalating issues appropriately.
  • Review submissions and supporting documentation before approval or execution, identify potential risks early, and coordinate resolution with the appropriate stakeholders.
  • Maintain accurate, current program documentation and knowledge resources; share learnings and request feedback to improve the support experience.
  • Partner with business and engineering teams to assess new customer or partner requests, clarify readiness and requirements, and establish next steps.
  • Maintain knowledge of program architecture, security requirements, and relevant platform or policy changes through internal documentation and training.
  • Coordinate secure provisioning, storage, maintenance, rotation, and retirement of keys, certificates, and other protected assets in accordance with security policies.
  • Manage identity groups, access controls, and time-bound access policies for protected resources, supporting least-privilege access and compliance.
  • Provide clear, consistent stakeholder updates on service events, asset resets, key or certificate rotations, revocations, and other operational changes.
  • Participate in regular service reviews and cross-functional meetings, raising current issues, upcoming changes, decisions, and dependencies.
  • Collaborate with partner teams to streamline workflows, mitigate incidents, clearly document improvements, and share repeatable practices.
  • Partner with 3rd party marketplaces owned by Google, Apple, etc. to understand enhancements in security or compliance requirements


Qualifications

Required/minimum qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Business, Operations, Finance, or related field AND 2+ years experience in program management, process management, or process improvement OR equivalent experience.

Other Requirements 

  • Candidates must be able to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:
    • Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

Additional or preferred qualifications

  • Master's Degree in Business, Operations, Finance, or related field AND 3+ years experience in program management, process management, or process improvement OR Bachelor's Degree in Business, Operations, Finance, or related field AND 5+ years experience in program management, process management, or process improvement OR equivalent experience.
